scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.build:client: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.cap:ios: cd frontend && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:android: cd frontend && npx cap open android
scripts.sync: py sync-env.py || python3 sync-env.py || python sync-env.py
